description: NIST's CTC-05, its AP203-with-PMI edition's solid #249 (the committed excerpt real/nist-ctc-05-ap203-torus-elbow-s5): the convex edge e256 between the rational B-spline face f109, degree (3, 2) over 2 × 1 spans, and the torus f111, filleted alone at the battery's radius 0.889. The edge's curve is a cubic B-spline that is no circle (off the best by 9.3e-3), the face's least principal radius on the ball's side over the stripe is 127, and both ends lie on the face's domain boundary with a cylinder across (f10, f19). At v84 the faces turn tangent within the edge's tolerance 7.7e-3, a vanishing end, and the exact ball's arc there is 1.98e-4 wide and 9.8e-3 from the vertex, past its tolerance 7.7e-3: no pole, so Arris refuses it TangentChain naming e256 and v84 (ADR-0062, step 9b). Open CASCADE builds a body BRepCheck_Analyzer finds invalid, of negative volume and area; its measures stay as the record and hold nothing (plans/nurbs-face-blend steps 1, 10a)
